plan.focus: Uptown's community programs and their founders

sources.name: Toto Foto
sources.quote: I love walking through Uptown on a busy Saturday like that. The market was buzzing, and it felt like everyone was out enjoying the day. I saw some familiar faces, exchanged a few hellos. The energy's always good there.

sources.name: Caroline Cabrera
sources.quote: I still see that numbers don't tell the whole story here in Uptown. The changes we're going through - with rents going up and families having to stretch to stay - it's not just about statistics. I've seen it firsthand with the kids in my after-school program and the people I talk to around the neighborhood. It's about real lives.

sources.name: Rafael Montez
sources.quote: To be honest, that 26% clearance rate in Uptown still sticks with me. It's not just a number; it represents real cases and real people. We're working to improve our follow-through and community trust. It's a tough spot, but we're on it.

sources.name: Priya Narang
sources.quote: The A's winning season still brings a lot of energy to Uptown. I started a jar on my counter to save up for season tickets next year. It's not just about the games, though - when they're doing well, the whole neighborhood feels it. The bars and galleries stay packed, and you can feel the energy.

approvedQuotes.text: I love walking through Uptown on a busy Saturday like that. The market was buzzing, and it felt like everyone was out enjoying the day. I saw some familiar faces, exchanged a few hellos. The energy's always good there.

I still see that numbers don't tell the whole story here in Uptown. The changes we're going through - with rents going up and families having to stretch to stay - it's not just about statistics. I've seen it firsthand with the kids in my after-school program and the people I talk to around the neighborhood. It's about real lives.

To be honest, that 26% clearance rate in Uptown still sticks with me. It's not just a number; it represents real cases and real people. We're working to improve our follow-through and community trust. It's a tough spot, but we're on it.

The A's winning season still brings a lot of energy to Uptown. I started a jar on my counter to save up for season tickets next year. It's not just about the games, though - when they're doing well, the whole neighborhood feels it. The bars and galleries stay packed, and you can feel the energy.
